d: IP30 Industrial L2/L4 8-Port 10/100/1000T 802.3at PoE + 2-Port 10/100/1000T + 2-Port 100/1000X SFP Managed Switch (-40~75 degrees C), dual redundant power input on 48~56VDC terminal block, SNMPv3, 802.1Q VLAN, IGMP Snooping, TLS, SSH, ACL, 250m Extend mode, supports ERPS Ring, CloudViewer app, MQTT and Cybersecurity feature)

specs.label: PoE Injector Port
specs.value: Eight ports with 802.3af/802.3at PoE+ injector function (Ports 1 to 8)

specs.label: SFP Ports
specs.value: Two 1000BASE-SX/LX/BX SFP interfaces (Ports 11 to 12) Compatible with 100BASE-FX SFP

specs.label: Connector
specs.value: Removable 6-pin terminal block Pin 1/2 for Power 1; Pin 3/4 for fault alarm; Pin 5/6 for Power 2

specs.label: Alarm
specs.value: One relay output for power failure. Alarm relay current carry ability: 1A @ 24V AC

specs.label: Power Requirements
